title: Resource Exhaustion in Tika Search provider in Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.11.0.M7 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows…
description: A resource exhaustion vulnerability exists in the Tika Search provider component of Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.11.0.M7 through 3.0.0. This flaw allows attackers to upload specially crafted attachments that exploit a known issue in Tika, leading to system memory exhaustion and denial of service. Users are advised to either disable the Tika provider or upgrade to version 3.0.1, which resolves the issue.
